parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(s.current_state, 'INFO') AS current_state, s.last_event_time FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy LEFT JOIN afd_states s ON s.source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'

INSERT INTO afd_states (source_id, current_state, previous_state, last_symbol, last_event_time, updated_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.source_id }}', '{{ $json.afd_state }}', '{{ $json.previous_state }}', '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}', NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state, previous_state = EXCLUDED.previous_state, last_symbol = EXCLUDED.last_symbol, last_event_time = EXCLUDED.last_event_time, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
UPDATE logs SET afd_state = '{{ $json.afd_state }}', afd_symbol = '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}', previous_state = '{{ $json.previous_state }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

SELECT message 
FROM logs WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5;

UPDATE afd_states 
SET 
    current_state = 'NOMINAL',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}';


INSERT INTO feedback_corrections (source_id, original_state, corrected_state, command_used)
VALUES ('{{ $json.source_id }}', '{{ $json.afd_state }}', 'NOMINAL', 'FALSE_POSITIVE');

INSERT INTO feedback_corrections (source_id, corrected_state, corrected_at)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.source_id}}',
  '{{$json.new_state}}',
  NOW()
);

UPDATE afd_states 
SET 
    current_state = '{{ $json.new_state }}',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
RETURNING current_state;

UPDATE afd_states 
SET 
    current_state = 'NOMINAL',
    ack_time = COALESCE(ack_time, last_event_time),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
RETURNING EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_event_time))::integer AS mttr_seconds;

SELECT 
    source_id, 
    current_state, 
    last_event_time 
FROM afd_states 
ORDER BY current_state DESC, last_event_time DESC;

UPDATE afd_states 
SET 
    ack_time = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}';

(
  -- First attempt: Find the specific service extracted from WhatsApp
  SELECT 
      a.source_id, 
      a.current_state AS afd_state,
      (SELECT message FROM logs l WHERE l.source_id = a.source_id ORDER BY classified_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS message,
      1 as priority
  FROM afd_states a
  WHERE a.source_id = '{{ $json.extracted_service }}'
)
UNION ALL
(
  -- Fallback: If the above doesn't exist, get the most recent service overall
  SELECT 
      a.source_id, 
      a.current_state AS afd_state,
      (SELECT message FROM logs l WHERE l.source_id = a.source_id ORDER BY classified_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS message,
      2 as priority
  FROM afd_states a
  ORDER BY a.last_event_time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY priority ASC
LIMIT 1;
